hero.dashboardDescription: Parlato is running in the background. Use your dictation key in any app to start talking.

settings.appearanceDescription: Same as computer follows your light or dark mode setting.
settings.autostartLabel: Start Parlato when my computer starts
settings.trayLabel: Keep running when I close the window
settings.trayHint: Parlato stays in the tray next to the clock. Right-click its icon to quit.
settings.setupAgainHint: Go through the first-run steps again: microphone, speech model and shortcut. Your settings are kept.
settings.hideDockHint: Parlato stays in the menu bar only. Open the window from the menu bar icon.
settings.soundsHint: A short sound when recording starts, stops or is cancelled.
settings.muteHint: Mutes music and videos so they don't end up in your text.
settings.resumeHint: How long to wait before unmuting once dictation ends.
settings.recorderPosHint: Where the little recording bar appears.
settings.formatHint: Adds line breaks and capitalisation to long dictations.
settings.spaceLabel: Add a space after the text

settings.clipHint: Whatever you had copied (text, images, files) is restored after pasting.
settings.fillersHint: Removes um, uh, hmm and similar.
settings.deleteDictationsHint: History and recordings are stored only on this computer.
settings.keepAudioHint: For replaying and transcribing again from History.
settings.versionHint: Parlato {{version}}. Installing an update restarts Parlato.
settings.releaseNotesHint: See what changed in each version.
settings.feedbackHint: Found a bug or have an idea? Opens the project's issue page on GitHub.
settings.madeByLabel: Made by Miguel Monzones, Craft Concepts Digital
settings.madeByHint: Parlato is free. If it saves you time, pass it on to a friend.
settings.basedOnHint: Parlato started as a fork of Parla, used and customized with permission. Parla itself is inspired by VoiceInk.
settings.licenceHint: Parlato is free software under the GNU GPL v3. The full source code is on GitHub.
settings.modelLicencesHint: Speech and AI models are made by other companies and come with their own licences. Parakeet Unified is licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.
settings.logsHint: If something goes wrong, attach parlato.log to your report. It records timings and errors, never what you dictate.
settings.deleteAllHint: Removes downloaded models, history and recordings, settings, logs, start at login and saved account keys from this computer, then quits Parlato. Do this before removing the app so nothing is left behind.
settings.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all Parlato data? This removes every downloaded model, your whole history with its recordings, your settings, prompts and power modes, the logs, start at login and your saved account keys. It cannot be undone. Parlato quits when it's done.
settings.deleteAllAfterMac: To remove the app too, then drag Parlato from Applications to the Trash.
settings.deleteAllAfterWindows: To remove the app too, then uninstall Parlato from Settings > Apps.
settings.supportHint: A coffee helps get Parlato signed for Windows and Mac, so nobody has to click past a warning again.

vad.title: Voice detection

vad.enableDesc: Fewer invented words in silent parts, and faster transcription of long recordings.

permissions.intro: Current state of permissions and system dependencies.
permissions.microphoneTip: If Parlato sees no microphone, open Windows Settings > Privacy > Microphone and allow desktop apps to access it. Also check the mic is plugged in and selected in Audio Input.
permissions.ocrDescription: Read the active window text for enhancement.
permissions.ocrTip: OCR uses the active Windows language pack. Add the language you want (French, English, etc.) in Windows Settings > Time and language > Language, then download the 'Optional OCR language pack'.
permissions.autostartDescription: Launch Parlato when your computer starts.
permissions.hotkeyDescription: Hears your shortcut in every app.
permissions.hotkeyTip: Parlato installs a low-level WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook which does not require special permissions on Windows. The default shortcut is Right Alt.

audio.hint: Plug a microphone in or check Settings > Privacy > Microphone.

ocr.hint: Add an OCR language pack in Windows Settings > Time and language > Language.

autostart.disabledHint: Parlato will not launch automatically when your computer starts.

mac.micNotAskedHint: Click Allow, then choose Allow in the macOS prompt.
mac.micDeniedHint: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone and turn on Parlato.
mac.accessibilityDescription: Lets Parlato hear your shortcut in every app and paste the text where your cursor is.
mac.accessibilityHint: Click Allow, then turn on Parlato in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility. It starts working within a few seconds.

miniRecorder.noConfigs: No config defined. Create a profile so Parlato automatically switches prompt + LLM + source based on the active app.

errors.apiKeyRejected: The provider rejected this API key. Check that it was copied in full.
errors.aiNotConfigured: Choose an AI cleanup model (and add its key for an online service) first.
errors.noWhisper: No speech model yet. Open Speech model and pick one.
errors.noParakeet: No Parakeet model selected. Open Speech model and pick one.
errors.parakeetIncomplete: Parakeet model {{model}} is incomplete. Re-download it from AI Models.
errors.cloudUnconfigured: No cloud provider or model selected. Open AI Models and configure one.
errors.shortcutReserved: Alt+digit is reserved for Power Mode profiles while recording ({{action}}).
errors.shortcutNeedsModifier: This key needs a modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win) ({{action}}).
errors.audioMissing: The audio file for this dictation is missing.
errors.fileUnsupported: This file type can't be read. Try MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG or MP4.
errors.fileNoAudio: This file has no audio track, or it is silent.
errors.fileTooLong: This file is longer than 2 hours. Split it into shorter parts.
errors.interrupted: Parlato was closed before this dictation finished. Use Transcribe again to try once more.
errors.pasteFailed: Could not paste into this app. The text is on the clipboard, ready to paste.
errors.assemblyaiRealtimeOnly: Universal-3.6 Pro handles this language only live, and the live connection failed. To transcribe this recording, pick another language or model.
errors.downloadOffline: No connection to the download server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.downloadRefused: The download server refused the request (error {{status}}). Try again later.
errors.downloadDiskFull: The disk is full. Free some space and try again.
errors.downloadChecksum: The downloaded file did not match what was expected, so it was deleted. Try downloading it again.
errors.downloadStalled: The download stalled. Try again: it picks up where it stopped.
errors.downloadFailed: The model could not be downloaded or saved. Try again.
errors.downloadingElsewhere: Another app (Talaan or Ensayo) is downloading this model right now. Wait for it to finish.

default.title: Default
default.description: Cleans up the transcription (grammar, fillers, formatting).

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Assistant mode: direct answer, no markdown.

hotkey.altGrTip: On AZERTY/QWERTZ keyboards, AltGr generates a synthetic Right Alt event when you type @, #, {, [, etc. Parlato detects and ignores those automatically.

record.title: Record a custom combination
record.hint: Press the keys you want to use. Need at least one modifier and a final key (e.g. Ctrl + Alt + R, F13, Win + Space). Esc cancels.
record.needsModifier: A standalone key is only allowed for F1-F24, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp/Down, Pause, PrintScreen. Otherwise add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
record.macReserved: Command shortcuts belong to macOS and your apps (copy, paste, quit...). Add Control or Option, e.g. Control + Option + R.

additional.cardDescription: Global shortcuts for the last transcription and for cancelling a recording. Not set by default.
additional.copyLastHint: Copies the last transcription (enhanced text if available) to the clipboard. Also in the menu of Parlato's icon near the clock.
additional.retryLastHint: Transcribes the last recording again with the current model and enhancement, then copies the result to the clipboard and adds it to the history.
additional.cancelHint: The assigned shortcut cancels the recording. Resetting restores the default double-Escape behavior.

voice.sameAsWindowsNote: Follows your computer's default. Switches when you plug in a headset.
voice.noDevices: No microphone found. Plug one in, then refresh.
voice.levelHint: Speak normally. The bar should reach about halfway. Too quiet? Move closer or pick another microphone.
voice.shortcutDescription: Your main key. The Default power mode uses it, and other power modes can add their own.
voice.keyHint: Change it any time. Custom lets you record a key combination.
voice.holdDesc: Hold the key while you speak, let go to paste. Best for quick notes.
voice.toggleTitle: Tap to start, tap to stop
voice.hybridDesc: A quick tap goes hands-free, holding works like hold to talk.
voice.secondHint: An extra key that also starts dictation.

hist.noneSelected: Tick dictations to export or delete them
hist.confirmDeleteOne: Delete this dictation? This cannot be undone.
hist.emptyDesc: Dictate anywhere and it shows up here, newest first.
hist.privacy: Text and recordings stay on this computer.
hist.privacyLink: Change how long they are kept
hist.againHint: Uses your current speech model and AI cleanup settings. The original stays as it is.
hist.againStarted: Working on it. The new version appears at the top.

ai.offNotice: AI cleanup is off. You can choose a model and add a key now, then turn it on with the switch above.
ai.tryDesc: Type or paste a sentence to see what the chosen model and style do with it. Works even while AI cleanup is off.
ai.tryPlaceholder: so um I think we should uh meet on tuesday at like three
ai.localDesc: Private and free. Works without internet. Nothing to sign up for.
ai.cloudDesc: Optional upgrade. Smarter rewrites, but you need an account with a provider and your text is sent to them.
ai.cloudEg: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Groq and more
ai.keyNote: Saved safely in your computer's secure password storage, never in a file.
ai.builtinDesc: Download one model to clean up text on this computer. Nothing leaves your computer.
ai.gpuSetting: The Use graphics card setting is under Models, in Speed and memory.
ai.stylesDesc: Your everyday style. Power modes can use a different one.
ai.screenTitle: Let the AI see the window you're typing in
ai.screenDesc: Helps it spell names and terms from your screen correctly. Read when you start dictating.

speech.noneYet: No model yet. Download one below to start dictating.
speech.cloudTimeoutDesc: How long to wait for an online service before giving up.
speech.importDesc: Use your own .bin file from disk.
speech.keyNote: Checked with the provider, then saved in your computer's secure password storage.
speech.hwGpu: your computer · {{device}} · uses the graphics card
speech.hwGpuMac: your computer · uses the graphics card
speech.hwCpu: your computer · runs on the processor
speech.groupLocal: on this computer, free and private

speech.onlineIntro: Runs online. Needs an account key from {{name}}, and your audio is sent to them.
speech.pickMostLanguages: The most languages, including Asian languages
speech.threadsDesc: How many parts of your processor the speech model works with at once. Automatic is the fastest choice on most computers.
speech.gpuDescMac: Runs Whisper and the built-in AI on this Mac's graphics chip. If it does not work, Parlato uses the processor.
speech.gpuDescWindows: Runs Parakeet and the built-in AI on the graphics card. If it does not work, Parlato uses the processor.
speech.gpuNoCard: No graphics card found, the processor is used.
speech.gpuFailed: The graphics card did not work, so the processor is being used. Turn this switch off and on again to try the card again.
speech.keepAliveDesc: How long the models stay in memory after a dictation, so the next one starts faster. Unloading right away frees memory sooner.
speech.confirmDeleteModel: Delete {{name}}? You will need to download it again to use it.

tf.aiOff: Off: you get the words exactly as spoken.

dict.wordsDesc: Names, brands and jargon. Parlato will spell them exactly like this.
dict.replDesc: Say a short phrase, get something longer. Handy for addresses, emails and sign-offs.
dict.variantsHint: Separate several spoken versions with commas.

pm.emptyDesc: Make one for an app you use a lot, like a formal style for Outlook or notes for Notion.
pm.pickOne: Pick a power mode on the left, or make a new one.
pm.confirmBody: Its paired apps go back to your normal settings. This can't be undone.
pm.startsDesc: Pair apps or websites, or press the mode's shortcut.
pm.shortcutDesc: While you are dictating, press this key to switch to this mode.
pm.pairedDesc: When you dictate in one of these, this mode is used automatically. No shortcut needed.
pm.fallbackDesc: Used in every app that isn't paired with another power mode.
pm.doesDesc: Anything left on "Keep my usual" uses your normal settings.
pm.speechModelDesc: The engine that turns your voice into text in this mode.
pm.languageDesc: The language you speak in this mode.
pm.autoSendDesc: Sends the message right after the text is pasted, handy in chats and AI assistants.
pm.aiCleanupDesc: Tidy punctuation and filler words, then apply the writing style below.
pm.styleDesc: Instructions the AI follows. Create new styles in AI cleanup.
pm.screen: Let the AI see the window
pm.autoRestoreDesc: Return to your normal settings once a power mode dictation is done.
pm.shortcutWins: If you press a mode's shortcut, that mode wins over any paired app.
pm.appNone: No app found. Try another word, or type its program name.
pm.appTypeName: Not in the list? Type its program name

ob.setupDesc: Four quick steps. About two minutes.
ob.later: you can change all of this later in settings
ob.micDesc: Pick your microphone, then press Test and say something out loud. The bar should move.
ob.micSettings: Bar not moving? Open your computer's microphone settings
ob.modelTitle: Where should your voice be turned into text?
ob.modelDesc: On this computer is private and free after a one-time download. Online services need an account key. You can change this later in Speech model.
ob.keyDesc: You will use this key whenever you want to talk. Pick one that is comfortable and that you do not use for anything else.
ob.tryPrivacy: Nothing is sent anywhere unless you picked an online service.
ob.autostart: Start Parlato when my computer starts
ob.autostartDesc: So it is ready whenever you want to dictate.
ob.accessDesc: macOS asks before an app can use the microphone or type for you. Parlato needs both: the microphone to hear you, Accessibility to hear your shortcut and paste the text. Nothing leaves your computer unless you pick an online service.

removeModel.bodyShared: This removes it from Parlato and from {{apps}}, and frees {{size}}.
removeModel.inUse: {{name}} is open in another app. Close it there first, then try again.
removeModel.oldCopies: Removed. A few old files were in use and will go after a restart.

whisper_tiny.name: Tiny (multilingual)
whisper_tiny.notes: Very fast, limited accuracy. Good for trying things out.

whisper_tiny_en.name: Tiny (English)
whisper_tiny_en.notes: English only. A little more accurate than multilingual Tiny for English.

whisper_base.name: Base (multilingual)
whisper_base.notes: Good balance of size and accuracy on a regular processor.

whisper_base_en.name: Base (English)
whisper_base_en.notes: English only. More accurate than multilingual Base for English.

whisper_large_v2_full.name: Large v2 (full size)
whisper_large_v2_full.notes: Very accurate, but needs a lot of memory.

whisper_large_v3_full.name: Large v3 (full size)
whisper_large_v3_full.notes: Latest generation and the most accurate. Heavy on the processor.

whisper_turbo_full.name: Large v3 Turbo (full size)
whisper_turbo_full.notes: Large v3 tuned for speed. Best with a graphics card.

whisper_turbo.name: Large v3 Turbo (compressed)
whisper_turbo.notes: Compressed. Very good quality for its size on a regular processor.

parakeet_v2_full.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English, F16)
parakeet_v2_full.notes: The reference model. English only. About 2.5 GB to download.

parakeet_v2.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English, int8)
parakeet_v2.notes: Compressed version. About 680 MB. English only.

parakeet_v3_full.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (multilingual, F16)
parakeet_v3_full.notes: English and 24 other European languages, and it detects which one you speak. About 2.5 GB.

parakeet_v3.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (multilingual, int8)
parakeet_v3.notes: English and 24 other European languages, and it detects which one you speak. About 680 MB.

whisper_large_v3_turbo.notes: Whisper v3 Turbo on Groq's servers. Very fast.

scribe_v2.notes: Transcribes while you speak, so the text is ready when you stop.

scribe_v2_medical.notes: Tuned for medical speech and terminology. Transcribes once you finish speaking.

nova_3.notes: Deepgram's main model. Works live or after you speak, and learns your custom words.

nova_3_medical.notes: Tuned for medical vocabulary. English only.

voxtral_mini_latest.notes: Transcribes once you finish speaking. Detects the language on its own.

voxtral_mini_transcribe_realtime_2602.notes: Transcribes while you speak, so the text is ready when you stop.

stt_async_v5.notes: Transcribes once you finish speaking. 60 languages.

stt_rt_v5.notes: Transcribes word by word while you speak, so the text is ready when you stop.

speechmatics_enhanced.notes: Works live or after you speak.

gemini_3_5_transcribe.notes: Google's dedicated transcription model. Transcribes once you finish speaking, and learns your custom words.

grok_voice_transcribe_2_0.notes: xAI's speech-to-text (Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0). Works live or after you speak, and learns your custom words.

ink_2.notes: Live only, and Cartesia's fastest. English only, no automatic language detection.

universal_3_6_pro.notes: AssemblyAI's newest model, 32 languages. Transcribes while you speak; when that isn't possible it uses Universal-3.5 Pro or Universal-2 depending on the language.

universal_3_5_pro.notes: AssemblyAI's most accurate model. Can transcribe while you speak.

universal_2.notes: Over 90 languages. Faster than Universal-3.5 Pro, but only after you speak.

whisper_small.name: Small (multilingual)
whisper_small.notes: Good balance of accuracy and speed on a regular processor.

whisper_small_en.name: Small (English)
whisper_small_en.notes: English only. More accurate than multilingual Small for English.

whisper_medium.name: Medium (multilingual)
whisper_medium.notes: Very accurate, but slower than Large v3 Turbo.

whisper_medium_en.name: Medium (English)
whisper_medium_en.notes: English only. Very accurate for English.

whisper_large_v3.name: Large v3 (compressed)
whisper_large_v3.notes: Compressed Large v3. Nearly the same accuracy at a third of the size.

granite_4_2_3b.name: Granite 4.2 3B
granite_4_2_3b.notes: IBM's newest small model. Accurate and faithful to what you said.

parakeet_unified_en_full.name: Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B (English, F16)
parakeet_unified_en_full.notes: NVIDIA's newest and most accurate English model. About 2.5 GB. Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.

parakeet_unified_en.name: Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B (English, int8)
parakeet_unified_en.notes: NVIDIA's newest English model, compressed to about 660 MB with the same results in our tests. Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.

nemotron_3_5.name: Nemotron 3.5 ASR 0.6B (multilingual)
nemotron_3_5.notes: NVIDIA's newest speech model: 35 languages, including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Arabic, and it detects which one you speak. About 2.6 GB. Provided by NVIDIA under the OpenMDW-1.1 license.

parakeet_ultra.name: Parakeet Ultra 0.6B (multilingual, int8)
parakeet_ultra.notes: NVIDIA's Parakeet v3, retrained by Moondream to make fewer mistakes, especially outside English and in noisy rooms. English and 24 other European languages, and it detects which one you speak. About 670 MB.

whisper_large_v2.name: Large v2 (compressed)
whisper_large_v2.notes: Compressed Large v2. Very accurate, with a much smaller download.

qwen3_5_4b.name: Qwen3.5 4B
qwen3_5_4b.notes: A small model that runs quickly, even on a laptop.

qwen3_5_9b.name: Qwen3.5 9B
qwen3_5_9b.notes: Larger and a little more thorough. Needs 16 GB of memory and takes about twice as long.
